data.title: BitMine ETH Treasury Nears 6 Million Tokens As Total Holdings Reach $17.1B
data.description: TL;DRBitMine Immersion Technologies has pushed its Ethereum treasury to within touching distance of 6 million ETH.A September 21 filing shows the company holds 5,983,940 ETH, alongside 212 BTC and a wider portfolio of cash, securities and strategic investments.
